description: July 1 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 1, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 1 birthday falls in Cancer, in the first decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: The July 1 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: July's first birthday sits at the close of Cancer's lunar decan, nine degrees into the sign. Birthday number 1 brings initiative to a sign that usually leads from behind. The 1st is often described as fiercely protective and quietly determined, someone who starts traditions, sets up the family group and defends their people without needing applause.

Astronomically, July 1 puts the Sun near 9° Cancer in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Moon. The Moon rules Cancer and also presides over its first decan, so roughly June 22 to July 1 is traditionally the most lunar part of the year. Feeling comes first here, often before words. Natives of this decan are frequently portrayed as protective, intuitive and deeply attached to home, family and memory. Their moods may rise and fall like tides, which is less a flaw than a rhythm worth learning. A doubled Moon can also mean holding on to old hurts longer than they deserve. Giving care to themselves as freely as they give it to everyone else is often the central lesson.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for July 1
paragraphs: Born on the 1st, your birthday number is a plain 1, with no compound behind it. In Pythagorean numerology the day of birth is a secondary number, a talent or flavour that sits alongside the Life Path rather than replacing it. A first-of-the-month birthday is traditionally read as the purest form of initiative: a self-starting streak, a preference for making decisions personally and a comfort with going first. Because there is nothing to reduce, the energy is often described as direct and uncomplicated. The usual counsel is to pair that independence with listening, so leadership does not become lonely.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a July 1 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 11 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous July 1 birthdays
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 1 is the 182nd day of the year (183rd in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Leo, is usually complete within 22 days, by July 23.

By July 1 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a July 1 birthday are Diana, Princess of Wales (1961), Agnez Mo (1986) and George Sand (1804).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 1?
faq.answer: July 1 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 1?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 1 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 11 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 1st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 1?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 1, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 1?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on July 1 include Diana, Princess of Wales (1961), Agnez Mo (1986) and George Sand (1804). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
